title: The Unknown
description:
Gameplay

In the Unknown You Will Roam Around Mysterious Dark Locations
Solving Mysteries , You Will Be Chased And Hunted By Monsters
Through The Night Battling Creatures and Solving The Current Objective

Find Fuses to Unlock Doors and Weapon Crates, Ammo and Health to Survive

Content
The Unknown Currently Has 2 separate missions to capture 2 unique and Scary
Creatures. Each mission includes a unique environment, story, gameplay, and monsters.
Have fun with your friends trying to complete each Objective and 
capture the supernatural Creatures.

STAY ALERT

Key Features
- Up to 4 Player Online Co-op
 Play Together With Your Friends To Survive

- Immersive Experience
 Realistic graphics and sounds as well as having minimal user 
 interfaces will ensure a totally immersive experience that will
 keep you on your toes.

 -Loot Crates
 There are Loot Crate all Around the Map Arm Yourself

-Proximity Voice Chat
 Nothing Better than Hearing Your Friends Scream In Distance

-Scaling Difficulty 
 The Creatures Will get Stronger as the Game Progresses

-Replayabililty
 Multiple Missions Multiple Creatures And More Creatures/Missions
 Will be Added as Time Goes one

-Respawn: The game incorporate a creative and dynamic 
 way to respawn, you will able to respawn up to 3 times.

And More Creatures Will Be Added Soon 

Development RoadMap
I Want to Keep Improving the Game Polishing and
Adding New Content to the Game Including

-New Monsters( Based on Childhood Classics and Creepy Pasta Monsters )

-More Environments

-New Puzzles 

-Improved Gameplay

-New Weapions
description_short: You and Your Team Of 4 Players Hunt down Paranormal Entities While Trying to Survive The Night Solving Paranormal Cases of the Unknown in this Online horror Multiplayer Game
